# AI Images Detectors Are Being Used to Discredit the Real Horrors of War

**Content warning: This story contains graphic images of violence.**

A free AI image detector that's been covered in the [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2023/05/18/technology/ai-chat-gpt-detection-tools.html?ref=404media.co) and the [Wall Street Journal](https://www.wsj.com/articles/ai-created-images-are-so-good-even-ai-has-trouble-spotting-some-8536e52c?ref=404media.co)is currently identifying a photograph of what Israel says is a burnt corpse of a baby killed in Hamas’s recent attack on Israel as being generated by AI.

However, the image does not show any signs it was created by AI, according to Hany Farid, a professor at UC Berkeley and one of the world’s leading experts on digitally manipulated images.

The image was first tweeted by Israel’s official Twitter account, as well as the official Twitter account of the country’s Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s office, after Israel, president Joe Biden, and several media outlets said that 40 Israeli babies were beheaded by Hamas in its attack. No evidence of these alleged beheadings have been made public yet, and that statement has been walked back entirely by the White House, and to a lesser extent, Israel.

# AI 影像偵測器正被用來質疑戰爭的真實慘狀

**內容警示：本文包含寫實的暴力畫面。**

一款曾被《[紐約時報](https://www.nytimes.com/2023/05/18/technology/ai-chat-gpt-detection-tools.html?ref=404media.co)》與《[華爾街日報](https://www.wsj.com/articles/ai-created-images-are-so-good-even-ai-has-trouble-spotting-some-8536e52c?ref=404media.co)》報導過的免費 AI 影像偵測器，目前正將一張照片判定為由 AI 生成。以色列聲稱，該照片中是一名在哈瑪斯（Hamas）近期襲擊以色列時遇害的嬰兒焦屍。

然而，根據加州大學柏克萊分校（UC Berkeley）教授、同時也是全球數位篡改影像頂尖專家之一的哈尼·法里德（Hany Farid）表示，該影像並未顯示任何由 AI 創建的跡象。

這張照片最初是由以色列的官方 Twitter 帳號，以及該國總理班傑明·納坦雅胡（Benjamin Netanyahu）辦公室的官方 Twitter 帳號發布。在此之前，以色列、美國總統喬·拜登（Joe Biden）和數家媒體曾聲稱哈瑪斯在襲擊中斬首了 40 名以色列嬰兒。目前尚未公開任何關於這些指控斬首的證據，且該說法已被白宮完全收回，以色列也在較小程度上改口。
